name: usage-hud
description: A small top-right HUD for context fill, auto-compaction, rate limits and cost; shows what each prompt sent along, steers compaction summaries, toasts each turn's cost and masks secrets

compactInstructions.title: Compaction instructions
compactInstructions.description: Added to every compaction's summary instructions (after any you type with /compact). Left empty, the built-in instructions shown here are used; type off to add none.
compactInstructions.default:
Write the summary so the work can resume without re-asking or redoing anything. Keep, with exact names (paths, symbols, commands, commit hashes, URLs):
1. The goal, what is done, what is in progress, and the exact next step.
2. Every explicit instruction, constraint, preference and correction from the user, quoted verbatim in the user's own language where short.
3. Each file created, edited or deleted: its path, what changed and why.
4. Decisions and their reasons, including approaches rejected and why, so they are not reopened.
5. Errors and failed attempts, with the cause and the fix or workaround that worked.
6. Facts the work depends on: how the code, tools and APIs actually behave, and the commands that build, test and run it.
7. Anything changed outside the conversation: pushes, publishes, uploads, installs, running processes, with their identifiers.
8. Open questions, and anything promised to the user but not yet done.
Drop pleasantries, superseded plans, and tool output already acted on.

turnToast.title: Turn cost toast
turnToast.description: After each turn, a toast with what it cost, how long it took and the tokens it wrote.

maskSecrets.title: Mask secrets
maskSecrets.description: Mask known key and token formats out of every row before the session keeps it, so the model and later requests never see them.

promptContext.title: Prompt context card
promptContext.description: Under each prompt you type, a card listing what went to the model with it: @ files, CLAUDE.md, hook and plugin context, engine reminders, pasted images, with estimated tokens.

themeColor.title: Theme color
themeColor.description: The HUD's base color as #rrggbb: every other color is derived from it, keeping how each sits against it. Empty or #6266b7 keeps the default palette, the one checked for contrast and color blindness. /usage-hud colors shows the colors in force.

colorOverrides.title: Color overrides
colorOverrides.description: Single colors to set over the theme, as name=#rrggbb separated by commas, e.g. warn=#ff8800, surface=#000000. Names: surface (the HUD's background; surface=terminal keeps the terminal's own), ok, warn, high (gauges), system, mcp, memory, other, messages (context mix), text, muted, label, mark, buffer, track. Empty changes nothing.
